page: Microsoft Azure D2nds_v6 is a general-purpose virtual machine provisioned via Microsoft Hyper-V. The system is built on x86_64 Intel processor architecture and allocates 2 dedicated vCPUs alongside 8.0 GB of system memory, establishing a standard 1:4 compute-to-memory ratio of 4.0 GB per core. The server contains no discrete GPU accelerators.

Storage capabilities include 118 GB of direct-attached local NVMe SSD storage, providing high-speed ephemeral drive performance alongside compatibility with Azure Premium Storage volumes. The instance belongs to the network-optimized classification within its family, though complimentary public IPv4 addresses are not bundled with the allocation.

Due to its compact two-core profile and included local NVMe SSD capacity, the D2nds_v6 offers balanced resource density and cost efficiency for non-distributed tasks. It is technically suited for lightweight database operations, web serving, microservices, container hosts, and development environments requiring fast local temporary storage.
